criteria.criterion: RED CONTROL VENDORED AND REPLAYED: the original four planning files are committed byte-for-byte under artifacts/product-reality/sprint-185/m04/controls/ and their census and generation stdout are re-executed against sprint base 1118f436 in an independently installed detached worktree at mission start. The 24-row generation table matches the original capture exactly: 12 error cells with only OODS-N015 (1/1/1/1/2/3 per schema per framework) and 12 pruned cells ok. The two cmos-activity-redesign control cells are separately measured at the same base and labeled as new companion measurements, because they were absent from the original generation capture.

TWELVE CELLS GREEN ON EVERY APPLICABLE GATE: for each schema x framework, fresh-exact-tarball-install, strict-typecheck, production-build, server-render, mount, hydration and shared-css-resolution pass. Interaction-evidence passes where the schema declares an enabled interaction; the-academy-landing-v1 reports not-applicable with reason 'no interactive element declared', and cmos-dashboard-redesign reports not-applicable with reason 'no enabled interaction declared; unbound PaginationBar defaults to zero items'. Dashboard pagination controls are separately verified visible and disabled with no state transition. The headline states 'N of M applicable' per cell; no not-applicable row is counted as pass.

INTERACTION IS DERIVED FROM THE SCHEMA, NOT THE SCHEMA NAME: the harness selects the first Tabs node (tab switch), else the first declared action (its native control), else the first field (typed input reflected in state); the per-schema-name branch at s184-m06-live-consumers.ts:1276 is gone; the s184 cells' expected action arguments are now derived and match the s184 recorded values

REGRESSION: the four Sprint 184 cells (subscription-list-dark and subscription-detail-dark x react/vue) still pass all eight gates through the generalized harness, with results byte-comparable to the s184 rows except for run-specific fields

THE HARNESS IS LIVE: zero reads of committed artifact JSON; the s184-m06 differential control (mutating an emitter source changes the harness output while the s183 committed-artifact harness is unchanged) is re-run on one of the new schemas and archived
HYDRATION DISCRIMINATES: pre/post-hydration DOM fingerprint equality with zero runtime errors per cell, plus one hydration bite per target on a NEW schema cell shown red then restored

CROSS-FRAMEWORK DISCRIMINATION ON THE FIVE: physically deleting DetailHeader's implementation declaration and named root export in one target, then rebuilding only that target, reds exactly the five target-schema cells containing DetailHeader while user-card-showcase and all six opposite-target cells stay green. Reverse direction is measured for React and Vue, then source is restored byte-for-byte and all twelve cells return green. Affected cells are derived from immutable schema content, not a literal assumption that all six use DetailHeader. Per-component bites for the other four reference m03's matrix rather than duplicating it.

B2 RE-MEASURED WITH A STATED REASON: b2-legacy-inputs.s184.spec.ts pins 'Component DetailHeader is not emission-eligible for react/vue' at the old detail input; that expectation is replaced by the measured truth at the same OLD input — whatever it is — with the reason recorded in the closeout (rule #1690). If Forge's object-aware detail context now generates on react and vue at build, that is recorded as a consumer-visible advertised move and a positive test at the old input is added
EVERY RAW LOG TRACKED: every log path named in the m04 cell rows is returned by git ls-files; the evidence-retention assertion is extended to sprint-185
